_meta.purpose: Fail-closed allowlist for NEAR AI Cloud model-node measurements. Values that are not independently published are tagged source=observed and must be treated as first-observation pins, not third-party proof.
_meta.os_image_hash_source: Phala Cloud OS image registry for dstack-nvidia-0.5.12: https://cloud.phala.com/dstack/0.5.12 (also listed at https://cloud.phala.com/verification/os-images).
_meta.mr_td_rtmr_source: observed from live NEAR AI Cloud TDX quotes on 2026-11-05 (Africa/Lagos). dstack does not publish a single MRTD/RTMR0-2 for a version: those registers also encode VM CPU/RAM/device config, so independent precomputation needs the exact VmConfig. Limitation documented in README.
_meta.compose_note: app_compose measured here is the dstack host stack (compose-manager / otel / certbot), NOT the model-serving YAML from github.com/nearai/cvm-compose-files. compose_hash differs per node mainly by INSTANCE_LABEL.
_meta.rt_mr3: NOT pinned: includes instance-id and runtime events. Verified by event-log replay only.
